title: 第 12 章 我不辩解只看小丑跳梁第 16 章 苏辰道德绑架索要资源
lines: 夕阳斜斜洒落在陆家大院的青石板上，院内气氛沉甸甸。周伯带着几名陆家老仆齐聚正厅，个个眉头紧锁，满脸憋屈。自打苏辰登门假意大度、转头大肆散布谣言之后，全宗门的负面舆论如同潮水，死死裹着陆家，大大小小的非议从没断过。

“少爷，外面谣言越传越离谱，不光说你练邪术篡改灵泉地脉，连早年一些鸡毛蒜皮的小事都被添油加醋编排，咱们直接去宗主大殿，拿出地契、人证，当众把真相全盘说清不行？”周手里攥着厚厚一叠整理好的灵泉地契文书，纸上密密麻麻记录着祖产来历、多年看管人证，实打实的铁证全都在手，却白白被全宗门误会，老人家心里憋得难受。一旁的赵小胖更是憋得脸蛋通红，攥着拳头急得来回踱步：“对啊少爷！我去挨个找之前受过咱们恩惠的外门弟子，联合起来当众作证，戳破苏辰的谎话，让所有人看清他的真面目！”
周遭几名陆家下人连连附和，全都觉得眼下最该做的就是当众辩解、洗刷污名，把颠倒的舆论掰回正轨。可陆衍端坐在石椅上，慢悠悠抿了一口凉茶，神色平静，轻轻摆了摆手，直接否决所有人的提议。
“现在出面辩解，纯属自投罗网，白白给苏辰送海量气运。”
一句话让满屋子人瞬间愣住，周伯满脸不解：“咱们白纸黑字证据齐全，明明占着道理，为何不能说理？”

陆衍耐心起身，走到窗边望向远处热闹的演武广场，此刻广场上密密麻麻全是青玄宗弟子，所有人聚在一起，还在吹捧苏心胸宽广、被夺机缘还能大度谅解，顺带踩一脚阴险卑劣的自己。“天道现在暗中篡改全宗门人的认知，普通人被气运潜移默化影响，脑子里早就被固定了刻板印象。咱们拿证据上前，在众人眼里只会变成恼羞成怒、刻意编造文书污蔑天才。苏只需要顺势装出委屈模样，几滴眼泪、几句示弱，就能靠着同情再赚一大波天命气运，咱们忙活半天，反倒帮对手锦上添花。”
经过接连十几次和天命之子、偏袒天道交手，陆早已摸透这套固定套路。前世原就是受不了非议频频当众争辩，次次落入圈套，被苏卖惨收割气运，一步步走向覆灭，自己绝不能重蹈覆辙。与其浪费口舌做无用功，不如闭门静观，等着苏得意忘形、自己不断露出破绽，等到合适的大型场合，再一次性放出所有证据，届时舆论反转的爽度才会拉满。
周伯和一众下人细细琢磨过后，慢慢回过味来，满脸无奈只能压下上门申辩的念头。赵小胖虽然依旧愤愤不平，但也信服自家少爷的眼光，乖乖收起外出找人作证的想法，转而听从吩咐，继续在宗门各处潜伏，悄悄记录苏辰的一言一行，把对方所有虚伪举动整理成证据卷宗。
打发众人各司其职之后，陆衍独自换上一身朴素灰衣，缓步走出陆家大门。如今全宗门到处都在讨论灵泉旧事，随处都能听见弟子们对自己的唾骂、对苏的吹捧。一路走来，不少弟子瞧见陆衍路过，纷纷压低声音指指点点，话语里全是鄙夷嫌弃，更有几名依附苏的外门子弟故意迎面嘲讽：“这不就是靠着家世玩阴招的陆大少？没本事靠修为赢，只会背地里耍小动作。”
面对当面的讥讽，陆衍面不改色，既不恼羞回怼，也不摆陆家少主的架子，目不斜视径直走过。越是淡然，在旁人眼里越是默认心虚理亏，嘲讽声反倒变得更加响亮。陆衍对此毫不在意，他的重心从来不在一时的口舌之争，出门本意是继续在外门地界寻访落难弟子，积攒良心功德，一点点消磨身上残留的天道厄运。

闲逛途中，陆衍路过丹峰外围区域，远远看见苏正被一众丹峰弟子簇拥在中间。此刻苏享受着所有人的恭维，脸上挂着标志性谦和笑容，随口谈论修行感悟，言语间不断暗示自己资源短缺，想要丹峰高层看在他天赋出众的份上，破格发放稀缺炼丹辅材。不少丹峰弟子被他的大义人设打动，纷纷主动开口，愿意帮他在长老面前求情。苏嘴上连连推辞，说不愿麻烦宗门、不想特殊优待，暗地里却悄悄记下丹阁各类稀缺丹药清单，心里已经敲定下一步登门索要的计划。
陆隐在路边的老槐树树冠之后，将这一幕完整收进眼底，默默拿出随身的空白玉简，把苏假意推辞、实则图谋丹药的细节一一记录，又多了一份日后打脸的实锤。
半个时辰过后，苏结束闲谈，带着一众追随者离开丹峰，转头去往内门长老居所挨个拜访，借着灵泉吃亏、自身资源匮乏的由头，四处博取长老同情，为后续批量索要资源铺路。一路上但凡遇上普通弟子，苏都会停下脚步柔声寒暄，处处展现体恤同门的模样，随口承诺往后修为大成，会帮扶寒门修士，每一次客套，都有细碎金色气运从天而降汇入他体内。
陆一路远远尾随，全程不动声色收集证据，等到天色渐暗才折返宅院。刚进门，赵满头大汗匆匆赶来，带来关键情报：“少爷，打探出来了！苏已经敲定主意，三天之后借着宗门月度议事的机会，当着全峰长老的面，以培养宗门未来栋梁为由，正式向宗门库房申请大批量高阶淬体丹、修炼灵石，还提前联络好了三名中层长老帮他联名举荐，到时候借着议事场面，明目张胆白嫖资源！”
陆指尖轻轻敲击桌面，心中了然，苏借着全网对自己的舆论优势，把所有算计铺垫完毕，就等着议事大会收割资源。自己依旧按兵不动，不提前拆穿，等到议事现场，再顺势拿出所有搜集到的人证物证，精准撕破对方的贪婪面具。
休整一夜，接连两日陆都在宗门外门区域四处行善，接连救下三名被苏跟班刻意排挤欺压的底层弟子，系统不断弹出良心奖励，体内功德稳步上涨，身上的天道压制一天比一天微弱，炼气巅峰的修为根基被功德反复淬炼，同阶之内几乎找不到对手。
第三日清晨，全宗门月度议事大典如期开启，各大峰长老、内门核心弟子尽数齐聚议事大殿，苏早早换上整洁青衫，提前等候在大殿之外，和帮自己说话的三名长老暗中碰面，敲定现场说辞，万事俱备，只等着当众开口索要海量资源。
陆衍整理好连日搜集的厚厚一叠证据卷宗，缓步朝着议事大殿走去。
就在动身的瞬间，系统骤然弹出紧急情报提示：【预警！苏打探到一处隐藏野外低级机缘，议事结束拿到丹药资源后，立刻动身前往寻宝，此机缘同样属于不义所得，是新的制衡目标！】

The setting sun slanted down on the bluestone slabs of the Lu family courtyard, and the atmosphere in the courtyard was heavy. Uncle Zhou and several old servants of the Lu family gathered in the main hall, all of them frowning and looking aggrieved. Ever since Su Chen came to visit, pretending to be generous and spreading rumors, the entire sect's negative public opinion has been like a tide, wrapping around the Lu family, with criticisms of all sizes never ending.
"Young Master, the rumors outside are becoming more and more outrageous. Not only are they saying that you practiced sorcery and tampered with the Lingquan ground line, but even some trivial things in your early years have been added to the story. Let's go directly to the sect leader's hall, take out the land deeds and witnesses, and tell the whole truth in public. No?" Zhou held a thick stack of Lingquan land deed documents in his hand. The paper was densely packed with records of the origin of the ancestral property and the certificates of the caretakers for many years. He had all the solid evidence in his hand, but was misunderstood by the entire sect. The old man felt uncomfortable. Fatty Zhao on the side was so depressed that his face turned red, and he was pacing back and forth anxiously with his fists clenched: "Yes, young master! I will go find the outer disciples who have been favored by us one by one, and unite to testify in public, expose Su Chen's lies, and let everyone see his true face!"
Several servants of the Lu family around him echoed, and they all felt that the most important thing to do now was to defend himself in public, clear away the stigma, and bring the reversed public opinion back on track. But Lu Yan sat on the stone chair, took a slow sip of herbal tea, looked calm, waved his hand gently, and directly rejected everyone's suggestions.
"Coming forward to defend yourself now is just throwing yourself into a trap and sending Su Chen a lot of luck in vain."
This sentence made everyone in the room stunned for a moment, and Uncle Zhou was puzzled: "We have complete evidence in black and white, and we clearly have the truth, why can't we reason?"
Lu Yan patiently stood up and walked to the window to look at the lively martial arts square in the distance. At this moment, the square was densely packed with Qingxuan Sect disciples. Everyone gathered together and praised Su for his broad-mindedness and his magnanimous understanding of being deprived of opportunities, while stepping on his insidious and despicable self. "Tiandao is now secretly tampering with the cognition of the entire sect. Ordinary people have been subtly influenced by luck, and stereotypes have long been fixed in their minds. If we come forward with evidence, we will only become angry in the eyes of everyone, and deliberately fabricate documents to slander the genius. Su only needs to pretend to be aggrieved, with a few tears and a few words of weakness, and he can earn a lot of destiny and luck by relying on sympathy. We have been busy for a long time, but in fact, we have helped our opponents to add icing on the cake."
After more than ten consecutive battles with Destiny's Son and Tiandao, Lu has already figured out this fixed routine. In his previous life, he couldn't stand the criticism and argued frequently in public. He fell into the trap again and again, was betrayed by Su and harvested his luck, leading to destruction step by step. He must never make the same mistake again. Rather than wasting words and words on useless efforts, it is better to sit back and watch, waiting for Su to get carried away and keep exposing his flaws. When the right large-scale occasion is suitable, all the evidence will be released at once, and then the public opinion will be reversed and the excitement will be full.
After careful consideration, Uncle Zhou and his servants slowly came to their senses. With helpless expressions on their faces, they could only suppress the idea of ​​coming to defend themselves. Although Zhao Xiaopang was still aggrieved, he was convinced by his young master's vision and obediently put away the idea of ​​going out to find someone to testify. Instead, he obeyed the instructions and continued to lurk around the sect, secretly recording Su Chen's every word and deed, and organizing all the other party's hypocritical actions into evidence files.
After everyone was sent to perform their duties, Lu Yan put on a simple gray suit alone and walked slowly out of the Lu family gate. Nowadays, the whole sect is discussing the old events of Lingquan everywhere, and you can hear disciples scolding you and praising Su everywhere. Along the way, many disciples saw Lu Yan passing by, and they lowered their voices and pointed, their words full of contempt and disgust. Some of the outer sect disciples who were attached to Su deliberately taunted him: "Isn't this Young Master Lu who relies on his family background to play dirty tricks? He has no ability to rely on his cultivation to win, and can only do small tricks behind his back."
Faced with the sarcasm in person, Lu Yan didn't change his expression. He didn't reply in annoyance or act like the young master of the Lu family. He walked straight past without squinting. The more indifferent you are, the more you feel guilty in the eyes of others, and the sarcasm becomes louder. Lu Yan didn't care about this. His focus was never on the temporary quarrel. The original intention of going out was to continue to search for the disciples in trouble in the outer world, accumulate conscience merits, and eliminate the remaining misfortune of heaven on his body.
While wandering around, Lu Yan passed by the outer area of ​​Dan Peak and saw Su Zheng from a distance surrounded by a group of Dan Peak disciples. At this moment, Su was enjoying everyone's compliments, with his signature humble smile on his face, casually talking about his spiritual practice and insights, constantly hinting that he was short of resources, and wanted the top management of Danfeng to distribute rare alchemy auxiliary materials in the name of his outstanding talent. Many Danfeng disciples were moved by his righteous character and took the initiative to speak out, willing to help him intercede in front of the elders. Su refused repeatedly, saying that he did not want to trouble the sect or receive special treatment, but secretly he secretly wrote down a list of various rare elixirs in the Alchemy Pavilion, and had already made up his mind to ask for them next time.
Lu Yin stood behind the canopy of an old locust tree on the roadside and took in the whole scene. He silently took out the blank jade slip he had with him and recorded the details of Su's pretended refusal but his actual plot to get the elixir. This would give him another piece of evidence that would slap him in the face in the future.
Half an hour later, Su ended his chat and left Danfeng with a group of followers. He turned around and visited the residences of the inner sect elders one by one. Taking advantage of Lingquan's losses and his own lack of resources, he went around to win over the elders' sympathy and pave the way for subsequent requests for resources in bulk. Whenever he met ordinary disciples along the way, Su would stop and greet them softly, always showing consideration for his fellow disciples, casually promising to achieve great success in his cultivation in the future, and to help monks from poor families. Every time he was polite, tiny pieces of golden luck fell from the sky and flowed into his body.
Lu followed from a distance and collected evidence quietly throughout the process. He waited until it got dark before returning to the house. As soon as he entered the door, Zhao sweated profusely and hurried over, bringing key information: "Young Master, we found out! Su has already made up his mind. Three days later, he will take advantage of the sect's monthly meeting to train the sect in front of the elders of Quanfeng. On the grounds of being a future pillar, he formally applied to the sect's warehouse for a large batch of high-level body tempering pills and spiritual cultivation stones. He also contacted three middle-level elders in advance to help him jointly recommend them, and then use the discussion scene to blatantly use the resources for free! "
Lu tapped his fingertips lightly on the table, knowing clearly in his heart that Su took advantage of the public opinion of the entire network to lay the groundwork for all his plans, and was waiting for the conference to harvest resources. He still stood still and did not reveal the truth in advance. He waited until the meeting was held and then took advantage of the situation to take out all the collected personal and material evidence, accurately tearing apart the opponent's mask of greed.
After a night's rest, Lu Du went around doing good deeds in the outer area of ​​the sect for two consecutive days, and rescued three low-level disciples who were deliberately excluded and bullied by Su's followers. The system kept popping up conscience rewards, and the merits in his body steadily increased. The heavenly suppression on his body became weaker and weaker day by day. The foundation of cultivation at the peak of Qi refining was repeatedly tempered by merits, and there was almost no opponent at the same level.
In the early morning of the third day, the monthly meeting ceremony of the whole sect started as scheduled. All the elders of the major peaks and core disciples of the inner sect gathered in the meeting hall. Su put on a clean green shirt early and waited outside the hall in advance. He secretly met with the three elders who spoke for him and finalized the speech on the spot. Everything was ready, and he was just waiting to ask for massive resources in public.
Lu Yan sorted out the thick stack of evidence files collected over the past few days and walked slowly towards the meeting hall.
At the moment of departure, the system suddenly popped up an emergency information prompt: [Early Warning! Soda discovered a low-level opportunity hidden in the wild. After getting the elixir resources after the meeting, he immediately set off to hunt for treasure. This opportunity is also an ill-gotten gain and is a new target of checks and balances! 】
